title: Administrator / Coordinator
description:
Are you an organised and proactive Administrator / Coordinator looking for your next opportunity in the Hull area? Do you enjoy supporting people, keeping things organised and being the person who helps make sure everything runs smoothly?

Would you like to work for a friendly, community-focused charity that genuinely makes a difference to local communities in Hull and across the wider Yorkshire & Humber region? If so, this Administrator / Coordinator job could be exactly what you're looking for.

Working closely with the Chief Executive, you'll become a key source of administrative, organisational and operational support, helping to coordinate projects, prepare reports and communications and keep important activities on track.

What the Administrator / Coordinator job involves

As the Business Support Officer, you'll provide high-quality support to the Chief Executive and across the wider organisation, including:
- Providing day-to-day administrative and project support to the Chief Executive, helping to coordinate priorities and keep activities moving forward.
- Helping to coordinate meetings, events, workshops and conferences, from invitations and registrations through to venues, materials and attendee communications.
- Carrying out research and preparing reports, presentations, briefing materials, correspondence and other documents.
- Liaising with colleagues and external stakeholders and helping to coordinate internal and external communications.
- Producing the charity's regular newsletter, including planning content, drafting articles and coordinating contributions.
- Keeping the charity's website up to date and supporting digital communications, including social media updates and stakeholder announcements.
- Preparing agendas and meeting papers, taking minutes and helping to keep agreed actions on track.
- Providing on-the-day support at events to help everything run smoothly.
- Providing reception cover when required, welcoming visitors and handling enquiries professionally.

You'll be joining an organisation that supports the voluntary, community and social enterprise sector, as well as delivering projects that help empower local communities, so this is a great opportunity if you'd like your work to contribute to something meaningful.

Skills and experience required

We're looking for someone who enjoys variety, takes pride in being organised and has a positive, proactive approach to their work.
- Previous experience within an administration, coordinator or business support role.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage different tasks and changing priorities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with good attention to detail.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office 365, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams and PowerPoint.
- A professional and approachable manner, with the confidence to communicate with people at different levels.
- The ability to work independently, use your initiative and take ownership of your work.
- A positive, adaptable attitude and a willingness to get involved and support colleagues across the organisation.
- You'll need a full driving licence and the willingness and ability to travel around the East Riding of Yorkshire and to other organisation sites when required.
- The successful candidate will be subject to an Enhanced DBS check.

Above all, we're looking for someone with the right attitude. Someone who is dependable, enjoys working with people, isn't afraid to muck in and takes satisfaction from making things happen behind the scenes.

Other Information
- Monday to Friday - 35 hours a week
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Car parking available
- Simply health plan available
- Flexible / hybrid working potentially available after probations

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Hull

Salary: £26,234 per annum

Vacancy Type: Permanent, Full Time (37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday plus 1 in 6 Saturdays (8.30am - 12.30pm)

Vizion Network is a forward-thinking organisation dedicated to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture. Located in Hull and Wellingborough, we pride ourselves on our commitment to employee development, wellbeing, and innovation.

Our mission is to attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent by fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered.

We champion equity, recognising that our strength lies in the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and talents of our people.

Through transparent practices, continuous development, and meaningful engagement, we strive to create an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

To provide professional administrative support within the Claims Team and to company Management / Directors. As a Customer Service Advisor, you will deliver the highest possible standards of customer service, be able to follow individual brand requirements and directives, ensuring that service level agreements and performance targets, both on an individual and team basis are maintained. The Customer Service Advisor is responsible for deployment, management and progression of motor claims relating to vehicle accidental damage, from initial contact, to repair handover and aftercare as required, keeping in close contact with the Bodyshop/Insurer and Customer throughout the repair process to ensure all SLA's are maintained and adhered to.

Role Profile
- Ensure that you are kept fully up to date with SLA's
- Ensure that you are aware and understand the KPI's the repairers are to adhere as a Vizion Member
- Ensure accurate processing and deployment / reallocation of claim notifications to repairers via rules driven in house management system within SLA
- To ensure hire sheets are recorded and updated correctly to ensure costs to the business and clients are kept to a minimum by constant management of hire periods
- Provide investigative feedback on any queries to the company and their clients where necessary
- To progress customer claims within the company's management system ensuring they are actioned within internally agreed SLA's
- Ensure daily tasks are managed within agreed SLAs
- Management of day to day body shop performance of KPIs, breaches, and cancellations
- To be responsible for building relationships within the repair network to ensure the smooth transition of customer repairs from start to finish
- Act as a first level point of contact for repair network members, clients, customers and team members and provide progress updates as required
- To receive incoming calls and emails and act promptly, dealing with all enquiries or actions in a professional manner
- Monitor personal and general inboxes and action emails within a timely manner
- To record all client issues and feed back to your Line Manager, Network Performance Analyst and the Management Team where necessary
- Assist with any reporting requested for analysis and management of the department/region/client
- Liaise with designated Network Performance Analyst and any other departments to seek assistance and resolution where required
- Work towards achieving targets set on a daily/monthly/annual basis provided by your Team Leader/ Line Manager
- Assist with other Advisor's caseload as and when requested to ensure full service provision
- Ensure that claims data is maintained and kept fully updated with information from all sources in a timely manner
- To ensure you provide accurate and detailed recording of all information utilising our management systems so as to provide comprehensive audit trails
- Promote data security in and outside of the business at all times, strict adherence to DPA and information security standards
- Adhere to stated Company Policies and Procedures and carry out all duties in a way which is consistent with our clients' values
- The completion of duties as required from time to time by the Management Team
- Manage complaints in line with policy ensuring full and in-depth information is captured and logged to enable full reporting on Expressions of Dissatisfaction
- Ensure that you process and resolve expressions of dissatisfaction within FCA Guidelines and internal/external SLA's
- To promote our business and that of our clients by providing exceptional and friendly service at all times

Person Specification

First class communication skills

Accurate data input skills

Ability to build and maintain relationships

Ability to work to agreed deadlines, targets and objectives

Able to work as part of a team as well as autonomously to a high level of accuracy

Good planning and organisational skills

Good problem-solving skills

Good decision maker

Commitment to providing a first-class service to customers and repairers

Customer focused

Good knowledge of Microsoft Office

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Are you an organised, proactive and friendly administrator looking for a flexible part-time opportunity within education? Tradewind Recruitment is currently seeking a reliable and experienced College Administrator to join a busy college in central Hull. This is to start ASAP, is a temporary position, and will initially last until about 18th December 2026.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an administrator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys supporting students and staff, and takes pride in keeping an educational setting running smoothly.

The Role
- Position: College Administrator
- Location: Central Hull
- Hours: 8:30am-4:30pm
- Working pattern: 2 days per week, with flexibility on which two days
- Pay rate: 15.00- 16.50 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications
- Recruitment agency: Tradewind Recruitment

Key Responsibilities

As a College Administrator, you will play a vital role in the day-to-day running of the college, providing efficient administrative support to teaching staff, students, senior leaders and visitors.

General Administration
- Providing comprehensive administrative support to the college office and wider staff team.
- Managing incoming telephone calls, emails and general enquiries in a professional and friendly manner.
- Welcoming visitors, students, parents and external professionals, ensuring they are directed to the appropriate departments.
- Maintaining accurate records, filing systems and confidential documentation.
- Typing, preparing, formatting and distributing letters, reports, correspondence and other college documents.
- Photocopying, scanning, printing and collating paperwork and teaching resources.
- Managing incoming and outgoing post and deliveries.
- Monitoring office supplies and assisting with ordering stationery and other resources.
- Supporting senior leaders and teaching staff with ad hoc administrative tasks as required.

Student Administration and Attendance
- Recording, monitoring and updating student attendance, lateness and absence information.
- Contacting parents, carers or students regarding unexplained absences, in line with college procedures.
- Processing student admissions, enrolment information, transfers and withdrawals where required.
- Supporting student registration and ensuring relevant documentation is completed accurately.
- Assisting with timetable changes, room bookings and the organisation of student appointments.
- Responding to student queries and directing them to the appropriate member of staff or support service.

- Has previous experience in an administrative or reception-based role; experience within a school, college or other educational setting would be advantageous.
- Has excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
- Communicates confidently and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
- Is confident using Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and Outlook.

- Understands the importance of safeguarding and maintaining a safe environment for students.
- Is reliable, punctual and committed to providing a high standard of administrative support.

description:
BOM Administrator

Location: Hull, UK

Salary: 28k - 30k

A Manufacturing company is recruiting for the role of a BOM Administrator who will be responsible for the creation and maintenance of an accurate bill of materials for manufacturing and after-sales within project and production timescales.

The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated and organised individual who has can work well under pressure ensuring an excellent standard of attention to detail.

You will have the opportunity to be part of a fast-paced, dynamic environment renowned for innovation, quality construction, stylish design and outstanding value! The Product Development department generate and maintain engineering drawings and bill of materials for every model, hundreds of drawings are created, modified and issued every week.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
- Working with the Product Engineer for each product group to develop an engineering BOM for each model, providing the rest of the company with expertise and technical support.
- Ensure Safety critical and Type Approval components are accurately identified on databases and BOMs.
- Assisting the Project Manager and BOM Team Leader on measuring the progress of projects by compiling and assessing KPI's and Critical Data information.
- Create and maintain bills of material with the aid of the Product Engineer for new products.
- Assess cost, weight and complexity of new models and refine such information during product execution.
- Liaise with other members of the project team to resolve process & operational issues that inhibit effective project delivery.
- Adopt best practice tools & techniques for project information work in order to maximise efficiency and quality of output.
- Link and update parts for the After-sales and IDOL data base systems with the latest data and photographic images.
- Support the D&D Technical Support Team with information and support with direct communication with customers and dealers when requested.
- Compliance with Health & Safety requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
- 5 GCSE or equivalent in English & Math and a high standard of further education (ONC or HNC level preferable)
- Additional qualifications or evidence of training in Data Management would be an advantage
- Familiar with BOM & database tools techniques
- Familiar with Microsoft Office programmes (Excel, Word etc)
- Ability to work under minimum supervision
- Strong problem solving & decision-making skills
- Ability to work well under pressure to achieve deadlines
- High level of accuracy in work and strong attention to detail
- Flexible, adaptable, enthusiastic and motivated
- Excellent verbal & written communication skills

BENEFITS
- 5 hour week
- 27 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
- Early finish Friday
- Easy access to site & free on-site parking
- Free Gym Membership

title: Logistics Coordinator

Hull

Assisting patients using the self check-in machine in the waiting room Arrange/book interpreters where needed for patients using AA Global either booking via their online portal or over the telephone Maintain accurate patient records and ensure confidentiality in accordance with the data protection regulations/GDPR. Document clearly & accurately Checking on the patients record if Third Party Consent has been granted if you are not speaking to the patient directly. Should no consent be documented on the record follow the practice policy and adhere to Data Protection, GDPR and Patient Confidentiality Process incoming mail either by internal post or external post and manage correspondence effectively. Opening, date stamping, initialing and passing all documents onto the correct team Process medication requests from patients face to face at the front reception desk, online requests via System Online or the NHS App, email, telephone (certain cohorts of patients only) or paper requests Maintain an organised reception area, ensuring it is tidy and well-stocked with necessary materials adhering to the surgeries Clear Desk Policy Accepting samples at the front reception desk following the practice process and passing onto the nursing team to action Utilise the use of our Extended Access Appointments on remote booking & CDC Centre Undertake mandatory training either online or face to face when required and keeping up to date with all training. You will also be required to monitor when your training is due for renewal. Attend PTL afternoons Follow and adhere to all Practice Processes, Protocols, SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and Practice Policies. You will also be required to keep up to date with any changes/updates Process cash payments for Non-NHS Private work from patients which is chargeable following the practice Private Charges list. Being responsible for issuing the patient with a receipt of payment, log/document in the patients record and place all monies in the secure Private Money Box, maintaining the money is kept secure & safe. Support the GP Partners and Nursing Team to chaperone in appointments as needed once you have undertaken the relevant training. Signpost and Care Navigate patients to the most appropriate care/service. This may include a Pharmacy First Referral, signpost to NHS111, Urgent Care etc Action tasks and other duties assigned to your work station that day.

title: Medical Administrator
description: We are looking for a reliable, enthusiastic and motivated individual who is committed to providing excellent patient care and is able to meet the requirements of a busy and growing Practice. We are a friendly family Practice, committed to delivering safe, high-quality services in innovative ways. As a large, well-established and forward-thinking GP Practice, we are proud to serve a registered patient population of approximately 42,000 patients. As our Practice continues to grow and develop, we are looking for someone to join our Medical Administrative Team who is flexible and adaptable to the needs of the service. This is a varied and rewarding front-line role, combining medical administration and reception responsibilities. You will play an important part in supporting our patients, clinicians and wider multidisciplinary team, helping to ensure the smooth and effective day-to-day running of the Practice. If you enjoy working in a busy environment, take pride in providing excellent customer service and are looking for a role where you can make a real difference to patients, we would love to hear from you. We welcome informal chats or visits, if you are interested, please contact Gillian Cawkill Head of HR & Governance gilliancawkill@nhs.net Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from individuals who require UK visa sponsorship. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. As a Medical Administrator, you will be one of the first points of contact for our patients and will provide a professional, helpful and compassionate service across a range of administrative and reception functions. Your duties will include, but are not limited to: Providing a friendly, professional and helpful first point of contact for patients, both face-to-face and by telephone. Handling telephone calls, digital contacts, practice emails and patient enquiries appropriately and efficiently. Undertaking medical administration and supporting the administrative elements of clinical triage. Maintaining patient confidentiality at all times. Contributing to the smooth and efficient running of the Practice. The role can be busy and fast-paced, and you will need to remain calm, professional and helpful when working under pressure. You will be expected to treat patients, visitors and colleagues with courtesy and respect and contribute to a welcoming and positive Practice environment. Working Hours 37.5 hours per week (full-time) preferred. We may also consider applications from candidates seeking a minimum of 30 hours per week. Working hours will be scheduled within the Practice's opening hours: Monday to Friday: 08:00-18:30 Saturday: 09:00-17:00 The role may include a regular requirement to work until 6.30 pm on Fridays. Candidates must therefore be able to work the required Friday late finish as part of their working pattern. We are looking for someone who is: Reliable, organised, and able to work effectively in a busy environment. Confident communicating with patients, colleagues and external organisations. Flexible and adaptable to the changing needs of a busy GP Practice. Able to manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. Professional, approachable and committed to delivering excellent patient service. Comfortable working across both administrative and reception functions. Able to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Confident using computer systems and willing to learn new systems and processes. Able to use their own initiative while also recognising when to seek advice or support. Committed to maintaining confidentiality and high standards of information governance. Able to demonstrate our values of Compassion, Respect, Learning, Quality and Integrity in their everyday work. Previous administrative experience and a strong background in customer service are essential. Previous experience of working within primary care, the NHS or another healthcare environment would be advantageous. However, we will provide training on Practice-specific systems and processes.
